name: Angry Multiverse Battlegrounds X (ENERGY)
desc:
A new fighting game I've been working on, hope you enjoy it!
PLEASE NOTE: Bugs can occur frequently. I haven't fixed many of them yet.
New Move Creator coming soon! (Will allow you to combine moves from different characters to create your own moveset.)

Last Update: Fixed a lot of bugs with the latest implications as it was very buggy.


Keyboard:
Q - Dash/Ragdoll Cancel
F - Block Hit
M1 - Punch
1,2,3, - Skills
